sentences.english: I can swim across the pool.
sentences.japanese: 私はプールを泳いで渡れます。

sentences.english: You must wear a helmet.
sentences.japanese: あなたはヘルメットを着用しなければなりません。

sentences.english: We should help each other.
sentences.japanese: 私たちは互いに助け合うべきです。

sentences.english: May I open the window?
sentences.japanese: 窓を開けてもよいですか。

sentences.english: You do not have to hurry.
sentences.japanese: 急ぐ必要はありません。

sentences.english: Could you show me the way?
sentences.japanese: 道を教えていただけますか。

sentences.english: It might rain tomorrow.
sentences.japanese: 明日は雨が降るかもしれません。

sentences.english: You must not touch that machine.
sentences.japanese: その機械に触れてはいけません。

sentences.english: My bag is heavier than yours.
sentences.japanese: 私のかばんはあなたのものより重いです。

sentences.english: This book is as interesting as that one.
sentences.japanese: この本はあの本と同じくらいおもしろいです。

sentences.english: Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.
sentences.japanese: 富士山は日本で最も高い山です。

sentences.english: She runs faster than I do.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は私より速く走ります。

sentences.english: This is the most useful dictionary.
sentences.japanese: これは最も役立つ辞書です。

sentences.english: Our classroom is larger than theirs.
sentences.japanese: 私たちの教室は彼らの教室より大きいです。

sentences.english: Today is warmer than yesterday.
sentences.japanese: 今日は昨日より暖かいです。

sentences.english: He is the youngest in his family.
sentences.japanese: 彼は家族の中で最も年下です。

sentences.english: I want to learn French.
sentences.japanese: 私はフランス語を学びたいです。

sentences.english: She went to the store to buy milk.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は牛乳を買うために店へ行きました。

sentences.english: It is important to listen carefully.
sentences.japanese: 注意深く聞くことは大切です。

sentences.english: I have a book to read.
sentences.japanese: 私には読む本があります。

sentences.english: He decided to join the club.
sentences.japanese: 彼はそのクラブに入ることを決めました。

sentences.english: We were happy to see you.
sentences.japanese: 私たちはあなたに会えてうれしかったです。

sentences.english: Please tell me how to use this app.
sentences.japanese: このアプリの使い方を教えてください。

sentences.english: She has homework to finish.
sentences.japanese: 彼女には終わらせる宿題があります。

sentences.english: Reading books is fun.
sentences.japanese: 本を読むことは楽しいです。

sentences.english: I enjoy playing the guitar.
sentences.japanese: 私はギターを弾くことを楽しんでいます。

sentences.english: She finished writing the report.
sentences.japanese: 彼女はレポートを書き終えました。

sentences.english: We are good at solving puzzles.
sentences.japanese: 私たちはパズルを解くのが得意です。

sentences.english: He is interested in studying history.
sentences.japanese: 彼は歴史を学ぶことに興味があります。

sentences.english: They kept talking after class.
sentences.japanese: 彼らは授業後も話し続けました。

sentences.english: Thank you for helping me.
sentences.japanese: 手伝ってくれてありがとう。

sentences.english: Cooking with friends is enjoyable.
sentences.japanese: 友達と料理することは楽しいです。

sentences.english: I stayed home because it was raining.
sentences.japanese: 雨が降っていたので私は家にいました。

sentences.english: If you need help, please ask me.
sentences.japanese: 助けが必要なら私に尋ねてください。

sentences.english: When I got home, I called my friend.
sentences.japanese: 家に帰ったとき友達に電話しました。

sentences.english: I think that this plan will work.
sentences.japanese: 私はこの計画がうまくいくと思います。

sentences.english: Although it was cold, we went outside.
sentences.japanese: 寒かったけれど私たちは外に出ました。

sentences.english: She was reading while I was cooking.
sentences.japanese: 私が料理をしている間、彼女は読書をしていました。

sentences.english: I will wait until you come back.
sentences.japanese: あなたが戻るまで待ちます。

sentences.english: He studied hard so that he could pass the test.
sentences.japanese: 彼は試験に合格できるよう一生懸命勉強しました。

sentences.english: English is spoken in many countries.
sentences.japanese: 英語は多くの国で話されています。

sentences.english: This cake was made by my sister.
sentences.japanese: このケーキは姉（妹）が作りました。

sentences.english: The window was broken yesterday.
sentences.japanese: その窓は昨日壊されました。

sentences.english: The letters are delivered every morning.
sentences.japanese: 手紙は毎朝配達されます。

sentences.english: Is this room cleaned every day?
sentences.japanese: この部屋は毎日掃除されますか。

sentences.english: Our school was built fifty years ago.
sentences.japanese: 私たちの学校は50年前に建てられました。

sentences.english: These photos were taken in Okinawa.
sentences.japanese: これらの写真は沖縄で撮影されました。

sentences.english: The game is enjoyed by many children.
sentences.japanese: そのゲームは多くの子どもたちに楽しまれています。
